history.author: Appsara
history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity Confirmation details.
features: This feature allows the user to generate EDI COPARN & Booking Confirmation for multiple PR at once.

events.description: Generates EDI COPARN & Booking Confirmation for the selected bookings.
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more bookings using the check boxes, clicks the Menu icon near Depot Activity and clicks Confirmation.
